records.official_source: ABCB/NCC official General NCC and Editions pages
records.application_question: Which NCC edition/amendments have legal effect for the authorised Watch Tower site/jurisdiction and approval date?
records.next_action: When jurisdiction is authorised, verify its adopted NCC edition and variations immediately before project BOD lock.
records.notes: ABCB states NCC 2022 Amendment 2 is the current NCC version on its general FAQ and that jurisdictions can consider NCC 2025 adoption from 1 May 2026, with adoption decided by each jurisdiction. Therefore no site-independent claim that NCC 2025 applies is made.

records.application_question: Does the applicable NCC/project structural basis reference this edition for general structural design actions and combinations?
records.next_action: Reconcile with the applicable NCC referenced-documents set and project classification before use.
records.notes: Standards Australia Store labels AS/NZS 1170.0:2002 Current.

records.source_or_standard: AS/NZS 1170.2 Structural design actions — Wind actions
records.application_question: What site wind region, terrain, topography, shielding, directionality, dynamic response and applicable referenced edition govern WT-001?
records.next_action: Do not populate wind speeds or multipliers until site and professional structural basis are authorised.
records.notes: Standards Australia announced AS/NZS 1170.2:2021 as the revised Wind Actions standard and notes it is referenced by the NCC.

records.application_question: Which WT structural components are actually reinforced/prestressed concrete and what project durability/seismic/material/detailing basis applies?
records.next_action: Use only after concrete components/materials and applicable referenced edition are reviewed; no RC strength or reinforcement assumption from geometry alone.
records.notes: Standards Australia identifies AS 3600:2018 and the current 2022 commentary supplement.

records.application_question: Which WT poles/frames/connections are structural steel and what grades/sections/connection/fabrication basis applies?
records.next_action: Bind actual steel components and material/connection evidence before any capacity calculation.
records.notes: Standards Australia announced AS 4100:2020 as the updated Steel Structures standard.

records.source_or_standard: AS/NZS 5131 Fabrication and erection of steel structures
records.edition_or_amendment: AS/NZS 5131:2016, subject to current referenced-edition check
records.application_question: What fabrication/erection requirements and construction category apply to accepted structural steelwork?
records.next_action: Verify current applicable edition/amendments and construction-category requirements during steel BOD/fabrication planning.
records.notes: Standards Australia describes AS/NZS 5131:2016 as the comprehensive fabrication/erection standard; edition currency must still be checked at project lock.

records.source_or_standard: AS 1288 Glass in buildings — Selection and installation
records.application_question: What glazing applications, wind/human-impact/special-use loads and tested frame/anchor assemblies apply to WT-OBS and wings?
records.next_action: Do not infer glass thickness/type/rating from render or pane geometry; establish tested assembly and applicable design basis.
records.notes: Standards Australia Store labels AS 1288:2021 Current and describes selection/installation for wind, human impact and special applications.

records.edition_or_amendment: AS/NZS 3000:2018 with current amendments including Amd 3:2023
records.application_question: What electrical installation, generation/PV, earthing, protection, isolation and verification requirements apply to the accepted WT electrical architecture?
records.decision_owner: Electrical engineer / licensed electrical designer/contractor / certifier
records.next_action: Populate only after electrical architecture exists; verify all applicable companion standards and jurisdiction rules before design lock.
records.notes: Standards Australia Store labels AS/NZS 3000:2018 and Amd 3:2023 Current.

records.source_or_standard: AS 1428.1 Design for access and mobility — New building work
records.application_question: Which accessible-path, doorway, circulation and facility requirements apply to the eventual WT building/use classification and scope?
records.next_action: Reconcile accessibility and egress concept with actual building classification and all applicable NCC provisions; current spiral-stair intent alone is not a compliant access/egress strategy.
records.notes: Standards Australia Store labels AS 1428.1:2021 Current.

records.source_or_standard: NCC Volume One fire resistance, egress, services and associated referenced standards
records.application_question: What class, effective height, rise in storeys, occupancy/use and fire-safety strategy apply to WT-001?
records.next_action: Do not enumerate project fire-system/rating requirements until building classification and applicable NCC edition are fixed.
records.notes: NCC is performance-based and given legal effect by each state/territory; exact requirements depend on classification and jurisdiction.

global_next_action: At authorised site/classification lock, perform a fresh official-source referenced-documents sweep, capture jurisdiction adoption/variations, and have discipline professionals set APPLICABLE_REVIEWED/NOT_APPLICABLE_REVIEWED before any numerical design use.
